What WE Do

sing. PLAY. DANCE. 
The Perfect Entertainment in Gulf ShoresKaraoke Nights​
Sing your heart out every night at Hibas from 8 PM to midnight. Pick songs from your phone, step up, and own the stage. Our setup makes it easy to queue your tracks and jump right in. Bring friends, grab drinks, and enjoy a lively karaoke crowd. Whether you’re a pro or just having fun, the mic is yours.

Get Directions Arcade Games
Test your skills with our mix of arcade classics and new games. Compete with friends or challenge yourself for high scores. Our games are updated often, so there’s always something fresh. From pinball to shooters, there’s a game for every player. Play, and relive the best arcade moments!

Get Directions DJ Sets​
Fridays and Saturdays, the party starts at midnight with our DJs. Dance to top hits and crowd favorites until 3 AM. Get in before midnight for free entry and start the night right. Feel the energy, enjoy great drinks, and keep moving. Hibas is the late-night spot for music and good vibes.

About Us 

Where Nightlife Comes Alive in Gulf ShoresHibas Karaoke & Arcade Bar is the best place in Gulf Shores for karaoke, arcade games, and late-night entertainment. Sing every night from 8 PM to midnight, challenge friends at the arcade, or dance with live DJs on weekends. Whether you’re out for music, fun, or drinks, Hibas delivers an unforgettable night.We offer a top-tier nightlife experience with karaoke, DJ sets, and arcade gaming, making us a must-visit destination. Our space is perfect for group outings, parties, and anyone looking for the best bar in Gulf Shores.With a focus on great service, safety, and entertainment, we bring the energy every night.
